summary: TrainMate uses Supabase Auth (GoTrue) via @supabase/supabase-js with email/password as the sole UI auth method (no OAuth, no password reset). The client is created with auth config { storage: localStorage, persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true } — session and refresh token persist in localStorage and auto-refresh. Auth state is centralized in an AuthProvider context (useAuth hook) that exposes user, session, loading, signIn, signUp, logout. Session restore subscribes to onAuthStateChange FIRST, then calls getSession; both paths settle the same session/user/loading state. ProtectedRoute gates all app routes on `user` with a full-screen spinner while loading and a <Navigate to="/login"> redirect when unauthenticated. The app treats user.id (Supabase User object) as the universal identity key (profiles PK, journeys, requests, chats, presence, reports, avatar storage); user.email is used only for display fallbacks. user_metadata/app_metadata are never read. Login.tsx has email/password inputs (HTML5 required), login/signup tabs, toasts for success/error, and auto-redirect to /dashboard when already authed — but it NEVER shows an email-confirmation hint and ignores the signUp response body, while emailRedirectTo is configured, implying email confirmation is expected but unhandled in UX.

supabaseCalls: supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => { setSession(session); setUser(session?.user ?? null); setLoading(false); })
dataFlows.uiBehavior: Listener registered BEFORE getSession so no auth event is missed. Both callbacks settle the same state: session, user = session?.user ?? null, loading = false. While loading is true, ProtectedRoute shows a full-screen spinner. On cold start with a persisted session, user is populated and the route renders; without one, user stays null and ProtectedRoute redirects to /login.

Button shows 'Signing in...' and is disabled while loading. On error: destructive toast 'Login failed' with error.message (e.g. 'Email not confirmed', 'Invalid login credentials'). On success: toast 'Login successful — Welcome back to TrainMate!' and navigate('/dashboard'). A separate useEffect also navigates to /dashboard whenever `user` becomes truthy (redundant safety path).

dataFlows.trigger: User submits Sign Up tab form (handleSignup)
dataFlows.uiBehavior: Button shows 'Creating account...' and is disabled while loading. On error: destructive toast 'Signup failed' with error.message. On success (no error): toast 'Account created — Welcome to TrainMate!' and navigate('/dashboard'). CRITICAL: the signUp response body (data.session, data.user, data.user.identities) is entirely ignored — only `error` is checked. If email confirmation is required (Supabase default), data.session is null, so no SIGNED_IN fires, `user` stays null, and ProtectedRoute immediately bounces the freshly-'successful' user back to /login with no explanation and no 'check your email' hint.

dataFlows.trigger: Email confirmation link click (redirect back to app at origin '/')
supabaseCalls: supabase.auth.getSession()  // implicit on app reload; onAuthStateChange fires TOKEN_REFRESHED/INITIAL_SESSION once confirmed
supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(...)  // sets user from confirmed session
dataFlows.uiBehavior: The emailRedirectTo target is `window.location.origin + '/'`, which is a PROTECTED route (Dashboard). On landing, ProtectedRoute shows the spinner while getSession resolves; if the confirmation completed, the session/user is restored and Dashboard renders. If the redirect lands before confirmation processing, user is null and the user is bounced to /login.

Modal closes, await logout() runs, then navigate('/login'). signOut triggers the SIGNED_OUT event → onAuthStateChange sets session/user to null → ProtectedRoute would redirect to /login anyway. No error handling: signOut errors are silently swallowed, and navigate('/login') still runs (if the session survived a failed signOut, ProtectedRoute would bounce the user back into the app).

supabaseCalls: autoRefreshToken: true → GoTrue internal POST to /auth/v1/token?grant_type=refresh_token
onAuthStateChange fires TOKEN_REFRESHED → callback sets session/user/loading
dataFlows.uiBehavior: Background refresh keeps the user logged in across page loads while the refresh token in localStorage is valid. No UI spinner during refresh since the callback still settles loading=false. Note: the onAuthStateChange callback sets loading=false on EVERY auth event, not just the initial restore.

dataFlows.trigger: Route navigation to a protected route (guard)
dataFlows.uiBehavior: ProtectedRoute consumes user + loading from useAuth. If loading: full-screen centered spinner (h-32 w-32 animate-spin). If !user: <Navigate to='/login' replace />. Otherwise renders children. Guards /, /dashboard, /matched, /requests, /chats, /chat/:conversationId. /login and catch-all * (NotFound) are public.

businessRules: All app functionality except /login and the NotFound catch-all is gated behind a valid authenticated session; route protection keys on the presence of the Supabase `user` object, not on a separately-stored auth flag.

user.id (auth.users PK) is the universal identity anchor: it is the profiles primary key, the FK for journeys.user_id, requests (from_user_id/to_user_id), reports (reporter_id), chat participants/sender_id, realtime presence key, and the avatar storage path. Every data hook (useProfile, useChat, useRequests, usePresence, useBlockedUsers, useAcceptedCompanions) derives its queries from user.id.

Display identity comes from the profiles table (name, avatar_url, college, gender, hobbies, bio) fetched by user.id; user.email is only a fallback for avatar initials and is shown in the ViewProfileModal; user_metadata and app_metadata are never read anywhere in the app.
Email/password is the only offered authentication method — there is no OAuth provider, no password reset, and no account-recovery flow in the UI.

Email confirmation is implied (emailRedirectTo is configured on signUp and Supabase's default requires email confirmation), but the app behaves as if signup auto-authenticates: success is treated as authenticated (navigate to /dashboard) with no 'check your email' hint and no session-awareness in the signup handler.
Sign-in success, sign-up success, and presence of a session all funnel to the same landing route: /dashboard.

Sign-out is explicit (ViewProfileModal Logout) and also implicit (SIGNED_OUT event clears context), with an explicit navigate('/login') after the await; errors during signOut are not surfaced to the user.
Session persistence: localStorage is the chosen storage medium, so a page reload restores the session without re-prompting for credentials, as long as the refresh token is valid.
edgeCases: Email confirmation pending after signup: data.session is null so the auth context never gets a user; the user sees 'Account created' toast, is navigated to /dashboard, then immediately redirected back to /login with no confirmation hint. Root UX gap.

The emailRedirectTo target is origin + '/' which is a ProtectedRoute — the confirmation landing and the getSession restore race; unconfirmed or slow-to-process confirmations bounce the user to /login.

Duplicate signup (email already registered): Supabase returns a 'User already registered' error shown in the toast, but Supabase may ALSO silently send a fresh confirmation email; the UI reports total failure and gives no path to request/resend confirmation.
Login with an unconfirmed email yields Supabase error 'Email not confirmed', surfaced only as a raw error.message toast with no guidance on how to confirm.
login/signup share the same email & password state, so switching tabs preserves entered values — an intentional minor UX quirk, not a bug.

onAuthStateChange callback sets loading=false on every auth event (including later TOKEN_REFRESHED/SIGNED_IN/SIGNED_OUT), not just initial restore; combined with React StrictMode double-invoking effects in dev, restore runs subscribe+getSession twice (cleanup handles it) — benign but worth knowing.

If the persisted session's refresh token has expired or is revoked (autoRefreshToken fails), getSession resolves with null user and the user is silently redirected to /login rather than shown an 'expired session' message.
signOut errors are swallowed (no try/catch in logout); navigate('/login') still runs, and if signOut actually failed the surviving session causes ProtectedRoute to bounce the user right back in.
Auth tokens live in localStorage, making them readable by any same-origin script (XSS exposure) — a known tradeoff of persistSession with localStorage storage.
No handling of signUp's data.user.identities: a signup where an identity already exists for the email (e.g. previously OAuth-linked) is not differentiated in UI.
notes: Client config (src/integrations/supabase/client.ts): createClient<Database>(VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, { auth: { storage: localStorage, persistSession: true, autoRefreshToken: true } }). Env vars are read from import.meta.env with no fallback/defaults, so a missing VITE_SUPABASE_URL or VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY yields an undefined-config client. Architecture: AuthProvider (src/hooks/useAuth.tsx) owns all auth state; useAuth() must be called inside it (throws otherwise). Auth wiring: App.tsx wraps AuthProvider inside QueryClientProvider/ThemeProvider/TooltipProvider and renders both shadcn Toaster and Sonner. Login.tsx (src/pages/Login.tsx) is public; all other routes are wrapped in ProtectedRoute. User identity display lives in ProfileMenu.tsx + ViewProfileModal.tsx (avatar initials from profile.name → user.email → 'U'; email shown in the modal), with logout in ViewProfileModal.handleLogout. Primary files: C:/Users/sward/trainmate-v2/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx, src/pages/Login.tsx, src/components/ProtectedRoute.tsx, src/integrations/supabase/client.ts, src/components/ProfileMenu.tsx, src/main.tsx, src/App.tsx, src/components/ViewProfileModal.tsx, src/hooks/useProfile.ts. The single highest-impact follow-up is handling the email-confirmation case in signUp (check data.session / data.user.identities, show a 'check your email' state, and remove the premature navigate('/dashboard')).
